questions.q: What does John call the one who was with God in the beginning?
questions.evidence: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God

questions.q: Where did Jesus do the first of his signs?
questions.evidence: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory

questions.q: God so loved what, that he gave his one and only Son?
questions.evidence: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life

questions.q: What did Jesus ask of the woman of Samaria at the well?
questions.evidence: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink

questions.q: What did Jesus call himself in John 6?
questions.evidence: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life

questions.q: Whom did Jesus call out of the tomb?
questions.evidence: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out

questions.q: What did Jesus wash at the supper?
questions.evidence: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him

questions.q: Which disciple answered, "My Lord and my God!"?
questions.evidence: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God

questions.q: What did Jesus tell Peter after asking him the third time?
questions.evidence: Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep
